scope: Optional standalone helper, generated private tickets and real OpenSSH askpass with encrypted test keys and isolated loopback sshd. Fixture broker supplies test answers; this is not the application frontend/state worker, password/2FA server, GUI, Windows or fair helper performance validation. No real user SSH files or credentials; records omit prompts, capabilities and answers. 30ms fixture response delay makes short-lived helpers observable.
